parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/2 mod.command: set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/2 mode sparse
set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/2 mod.explanation: 配置PIM协议在指定接口上的模式。

set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/1 mod.command: set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/1 mode sparse
set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/1 mod.explanation: 配置PIM协议在指定接口上的模式。

set protocols pim rp static address 192..template: set protocols pim rp static address [parameter1]
set protocols pim rp static address 192..command: set protocols pim rp static address 192.168.3.1

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] remote-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 192.168.1.2 remote-as 100
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.explanation: 配置BGP协议的邻居及其远程AS号。

set protocols bgp group external-peers f.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.explanation: 配置BGP协议组支持的地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers e.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers export advertise-routes
set protocols bgp group external-peers e.explanation: 配置BGP协议组的导出策略。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.3.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set policy-options policy-statement adve.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3]/[parameter4] [parameter5]
set policy-options policy-statement adve.command: set policy-options policy-statement advertise-routes term 1 from route-filter 192.168.1.0/24 exact
set policy-options policy-statement adve.explanation: 配置策略语句中的条件，用于匹配特定的路由。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 策略语句中的条件项编号。

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: 路由过滤器，用于匹配特定的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement adve.command: set policy-options policy-statement advertise-routes then accept
set policy-options policy-statement adve.explanation: 配置策略语句中的动作，用于接受匹配的路由。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。
